comparison: iPhone13,1 iOS 27.0.1 (24A446) vs iOS 27.2 (24B119), AppleAVE2 and AppleH11ANEInterface

kext_inventory.note: ipsw kernel kexts and the MH_FILESET entry count are different inventories and are not interchangeable.

limitations: The extracted kexts are stripped; no symbol-level method names were recovered for the changed functions.
A version change and a function-hash difference are build-level observations, not proof of a specific security fix.
Shape matches can be inflated by layout-dependent immediate changes; exact matches are the stronger identity signal.
No device was connected; runtime behavior and exploitability were not measured.

vtable_diff.source: ipsw kernel cpp --json --methods -e <bundle> on the 24A446 and 24B119 kernelcaches; targets mapped to extracted kext function hashes
